decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would more than double the floor space of this out-of-town-centre office building, which is not within a designated employment area and not readily accessible by sustainable modes of transport. No sequential test information has been provided to demonstrate that the proposal is in the most sustainable location. The proposal is therefore contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies IMP.4.1 (Primary Locations for Economic Development), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.1 (Location of New Employment Development) and E.1.2 (Locations for Business (B1) Use).

Condition : 2 - The proposed office extension, by reason of its size, design and position significantly forward of the established building line, would result in an incongruous and overbearing development, which would be at odds with the character of the area, harmful to the street scene contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria).

Condition : 3 - The proposed off-street parking provision would significantly exceed the Council's maximum parking standards, and therefore would fail to meet the Council's objectives for sustainable patterns of transport, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking & Servicing Facilities for Developments).
description: Erection of a three storey side extension and erection of a third storey to existing office building with associated parking & landscaping.
